text_block_list.text:
The king, felled by the princess's blade!
Oh, the
power of a revolution! However,
it is not enough
to defeat me!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
I turn to my potential eternal adversary
and say,
"Steel yourself and stand tall as
my nemesis!" Such
words could be given
to myself as well.
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
Look around at what my feats have
produced—a
horde of enemies
threatening to hinder my true
stride. Lo!
A challenge worthy of a king if I've
ever
seen one!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
Now is the time to press forward and
build a
dynasty. My nation will witness
its foundation at
the Japan Cup!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
